title: Tally v2.1.2 AI non-human cross-model review decision
description: Versioned decision row of the R180 AI cross-model review evidence ledger (GPT/GLM/Qwen, three actual distinct model families). Each row binds one original Claim/Evidence/Locator chain by exact record versions and canonical SHA-256 digests, records the scoped non-human review outcome, and forbids every promotion path: no Claim lifecycle transition, no in-graph ReviewDecision, no human professional Oracle attestation, no publisher rights grant, no SAP/Root/Global/R8/Effect/Release qualification. A stale digest/version, a duplicated model family, a forged family identity (e.g. GLM presented as Gemini) or an elevated pending leg fails closed.
x-quorum-rule: The ledger quorum requires three receipts from three ACTUAL distinct model families, unanimous ACCEPT_SCOPED per claim, and P0=P1=0 on every receipt. Two receipts of the same family (duplicate-model counting) or any receipt whose family label contradicts its own disclosure (forged identity, e.g. GLM presented as Gemini) must fail closed. The Gemini lane itself remains NOT_RUN.
x-qualification-boundary: An AI cross-model review decision is non-human review evidence only. It is not a human or professional Oracle attestation, not a publisher authorization, not a Claim lifecycle transition, and does not create in-graph ReviewDecision nodes (the count must remain exactly 0).
